releases.body:
# Am MOD r30b

Для **Akai MPC Sample, прошивка 1.3.0.12**. Обновление не переписывает системную прошивку.

- **SD Card Access:** доступ к карте как USB-диску, обновление мода через USB и возврат **B3 Disconnect → B3 Return** после безопасного извлечения в ОС.
- **USB audio:** Stereo Master для телефона/ПК или **Master + A–H — 18 каналов / девять стереопар**. Названия сообщает сам MPC. В Stock сохраняется стереорежим.
- **FX:** новые экраны Tape Delay, Tape, Vinyl, Shimmer и других эффектов; 12 обновлённых GIF, отдельные раскладки K1–K3/Shift, семь гитарных/басовых Amp-вариантов.
- **Звук и управление:** фоновый тюнер, плавные изменения FX, согласованные Copy/Paste/Bypass, DATA и выделение Duck/OptoCat, takeover и фильтрация обратных петель в Route.
- **Sample Record:** исправлены индикатор мониторинга, Stop в Routing и лишний Rec Input Effects в Am MOD. Для записи/мониторинга с Input FX выберите **Record FX = Wet**.

## Установка / Install

Сделайте копию проектов и сэмплов. Скачайте **am-mod-r30b.zip** и установщик ниже. Установите полный пакет, безопасно извлеките диск, вернитесь через B3 → B3 и **выключите/включите MPC**. Уже работающая RAM-версия от копирования не меняется.

Back up projects/samples, install the complete ZIP, safely eject, return with B3 → B3 and **restart the MPC**. Save to External. USB mode changes also require restart. Stereo is the phone profile; individual phone/adapter compatibility varies.

**Не включайте петлю мониторинга DAW ↔ MPC USB Return.** SD Card Access останавливает приложение и звук на время передачи.

[Все изменения / Русский](https://github.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/blob/r30b/docs/RELEASE_NOTES-r30b.ru.md) · [Full English notes](https://github.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/blob/r30b/docs/RELEASE_NOTES-r30b.md) · [USB](https://github.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/blob/r30b/docs/USB_GUIDE.ru.md) · [Руководство](https://github.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/blob/r30b/docs/USER_GUIDE.ru.md) · [FX gallery](https://github.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/blob/r30b/docs/FX_GALLERY.md)

![Tape Delay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlekseyMalykh/am-mod/r30b/docs/media/fx/tape-delay.gif)

GIF отрисована текущим painter-кодом на синтетическом сигнале; это не запись устройства. Границы аппаратной/автоматической проверки указаны в release notes. SHA-256 всех вложений — в **SHA256SUMS.txt**. Соответствующие GPL-исходники модуля USB включены в ZIP.

releases.name: Am MOD r30a
releases.body:
# Am MOD r30a

The first release with the mixer, the input channel, resampling through the mixer and the tuner. Firmware **1.3.0.12** only.

## Read this first

- **The "SD Card Access" item is hidden** in the Project menu (Shift+Pad 16) in both modes. USB transfer mode ("the card as a drive on your computer") cannot work while the mod runs: the app runs in an isolated copy without access to raw storage devices, and the card is in use by the mod. The item was removed for safety. Use a card reader; to get USB mode back, remove `autorun/` from the card and start the MPC.
- **Two modes: Stock and Am MOD.** Project → Mod Settings → Quick → FX mode, applied after a restart. *Stock*: the stock FX Select (one effect), no mixer. *Am MOD*: the mixer replaces FX Select; Knob FX opens the mixer; a stock FX Select effect saved in a project is ignored. Signal-path diagrams for both modes (EN/RU) are in the README.
- Back up projects and samples before updating. Save to **External**.

## What is new

- **Mixer**: tracks A–H and Master, four insert effects per track, sends, sidechain, Song stems to the SD card.
- **Input channel** (mixer pad 15): Level, Pan, Mute, Input FX; recording point **Input / Track A–H / Master**, **Wet / Dry**; monitoring follows the record point; Rear modes.
- **Resample** a pad (Shift+Pad 11 in Sample) or a sequence (Shift+Pad 11 in Seq) through the mixer, with a destination dialog, Replace confirmation, stop confirmation and independent bank handling.
- **Tuner**: input (mixer Input ROUTE, Sample Record B3) and the sample of any pad (Stop+Chop in Sample); B3 "Orig note" stores the original note.
- **Pad colour from Track** on every screen with pad sounds.
- New illustrated effect screens, typing names with the pads, Master compressor OptoCat/Duck.

## Bugs fixed

- Save Project / Save Sample: false "Insert SD card" and saving to Internal.
- Stems export with an External Export window; the Stems name window now accepts pads at once.
- Resampled pad lost its attack; sequence resample skipped the mixer and could be silent at first start.
- Recording through Track or Master stayed dry.
- A stock FX Select effect sounded in Am MOD; one selected pad made Knob FX hit every pad.
- Pad colours turned stock under native dialogs.
- Resample dialog: Pad Bank stepping, bank letters, stop confirmation, Replace prompt with red target and hint (sequences), destination bank independent of the sequence bank.
- Compressor pad pick showed free-green / occupied-red like a destination: now a normal blinking selection.
- Seq+Sample window lit pads differently from Sample: now the same rules.
- Shift+Erase in the mixer started the stock copy gesture; K3 Volume in the sample library blinked; Master FX pinned Sample Comp row.

## Known

- Rare short crackle in the tuner window on very low notes.
- A missing sequence cursor in Song was seen once and could not be reproduced.

## Thanks

Huge thanks to **Leusha** for careful, detailed testing and for finding bugs: most of the fixes above started from those reports. Thanks also to mxt1iga and everyone who tested builds.

releases.name: Am MOD r29a
releases.body:
# Am MOD r29a — new effect screens, SD stems and pad typing Release for Akai MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12**, 13 November 2026. Replaces the pre-release r28e-fx2 (and r28e-fx3 … fx16, which were test builds). Host and package checks passed; the new Save, Stems and text-input behaviour was tried on a device while it was being built. **Back up projects and samples before updating.** Projects that use the effects added in r28e-fx2 do not load in older Am MOD versions.
Tape Delay
 Tape (cassette)
Vinyl
 Spring Reverb
Tube Drive
 Multi Chorus
Pitch Shifter
 Ensemble
Frames rendered from the mod's own painter with a test signal, not recorded from a device. More animations are in [media/fx](media/fx). ## What's new - **New effect screens.** Every effect picture was redrawn: the value strip under the picture is gone (the values are on the parameter panel), each picture has a small *AM MOD* plate in its category colour, and many are now a real object. **Tape Delay** is a reel-to-reel with wooden cheeks, tape running tangentially to guide rollers and a red erase head. **Tape** is a cassette: the left tape pack, a VU meter whose needle follows the signal level, and **PLAY** / **STOP** keys (PLAY is down while sound runs, STOP when it stops; the reels turn only while playing). **Vinyl** is a turntable with a short tonearm and record shelves on both sides. Also redrawn: Sample Delay, Spring Reverb (spring tank), Tube Drive (glowing tubes), Soft Clipper (transfer curve and waveform), Ensemble (three voices and their sum), Multi Chorus (LFO circle), Auto Wah (pedal and sweep), Pitch Shifter (keyboard), Flanger and Bit Crusher. - **Typing with the pads is the default** wherever a name or text is entered: Search, Save Project / Sample, Export, Stems and track names in the Mixer. **K1 still switches to Encoder.** New Mod Setting: **Quick → Text input: Pads / Encoder**, saved on the card. - **Shift+Erase clears the whole text** in every pad-input window (Search already did). Erase still deletes one character. - **The first Mod Settings tab is now called Quick** (it was Pads); FX view is there. - **Stems go to the SD card** in a folder named after the song: `Samples/User/Export//`. The folder holds one file per sounding Track named `_track A.wav`, or `_track A_.wav` if the Track was renamed, and **`_Master.wav`** (the stock mixdown). ## Fixed - **Save Project and Save Sample could save to Internal.** The windows now open with External selected and force it back to External when K3 is turned. - **Stems export failed** (`SD_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE`) when the stock Export window offered External. Stems now always go to the card, whichever destination the window shows, and no stray mixdown file is left in `Samples/Export`. - **The Stems name window showed Pads but the pads did not respond** until K1 was toggled. Pads now work as soon as the window opens. - **Master FX no longer shows a pinned Sample Comp row.** It only existed after Shift+Pad 5 had been opened once, and the Duck type had no Master view, so it was N/A or missing at start. Add **OptoCat Comp** from the effect list instead. - Tape needles, idle and bypassed pictures and other small drawing issues of the redrawn screens. ## Tested and not yet tested Host checks with sanitizers and the package checks passed, including new tests for the name editor (Pads default, Shift+Erase) and the Text input setting. Tried on a device while building: Save External-only and Stems export (folder, names, Master). Not tested on a device: all redrawn pictures (frame time, readability on the real screen), Shift+Erase in every native window, the Text input setting after a power cycle. ## Known limits - The stock Master FX effect from Pad FX / Program is not shown in the mixer yet. - The Vintage Emulator *Type* list is not named yet. - Seq Record in the mixer is still unused; recording parameter automation is planned. - Auto Wah and Amp Sim pictures are mostly static in the preview animations because the test signal does not move their controls. ## Installation Select `am-mod-r29a.zip` in MPC Sample Mod Installer, or copy its complete `autorun/` folder to the SD card root, replacing the previous mod files. Restart with the card inserted and check r29a in About. Back up first; the installer keeps a copy of the previous `autorun/`. ## How to use 1. **Typing:** names and search open in Pads mode. Press K1 for Encoder. Erase deletes a character, Shift+Erase clears everything. 2. **Default input:** Mod Settings → Quick → Text input. 3. **Stems:** Song → Export → Stems, enter a name; files appear on the card in `Samples/User/Export//`. 4. **Effect pictures:** Mod Settings → Quick → FX view: Illustrated / Classic. [Русский](RELEASE_NOTES-r29a.ru.md)

**Six free studio effects for the Akai MPC Sample**: HS Saturator, HS Air Exciter, HS Channel Strip, HS Drive Sat, HS Bus Compressor and HS Para EQ. Plus live effect displays, an EQ grid and the HenrySkillz start screen.

### Install (about 15 minutes, no coding)
1. Back up your SD card.
2. Download **SampQOL-OS-v0.2.0.zip** from [Snare Bes's official page](https://github.com/snarebes/SampQOL-OS/releases).

New to this? **[Step-by-step guide](https://github.com/hmukhwana/henryskillz-mpc-sample-mod-kit/blob/main/docs/INSTALL-GUIDE.md)** · [FAQ](https://github.com/hmukhwana/henryskillz-mpc-sample-mod-kit/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md) · [Undo it](https://github.com/hmukhwana/henryskillz-mpc-sample-mod-kit/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY.md)

MPC Sample on firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12) · SampQOL OS 0.2.0 exactly · an exFAT SD card · a web browser.

### Tested
The installer on the official SampQOL 0.2.0 download (Chrome and Safari), and this exact build booted end to end in an MPC Sample emulator, with all six HS effects loading. The effects have run on Henry's own MPC Sample. Back up your card first, and [report anything odd](https://github.com/hmukhwana/henryskillz-mpc-sample-mod-kit/issues).

### Credit

Track Mute shows unused tracks as (Unused). Save/Load, the metronome and the envelope page have the XL's pictures. Start-up reads MPC 600 S Version 1.7.

**New: USB Data Mode.** Save/Load, Mode USB DATA, <Start>: the SD card becomes a USB drive on a computer without taking it out. Copy files, eject the drive on the computer, press <Exit>. Use a USB data cable; a charge-only cable powers the MPC but the computer will not see the drive.

**Fixed: pages opening by themselves.** The page buttons (KNOB FX, PAD FX, MUTE, LEVELS, LOOP, CHOP, SAMPLE SELECT, SEQ, SAMPLE REC, PAD BANK) now act only on a whole press, down then up, held 12 ms to 4 s. A release with no press is ignored, and an ERASE tap under 12 ms is ignored (the Erase page no longer opens while turning the wheel).

**Fixed: pad 12 lit yellow at start-up** with Pad Lights OFF.

**Fixed: sounds missing from Sample: / Snd:.** A sound a pad lets go of stays in memory unless another pad plays it; loading or recording over a pad keeps the old sound. Memory holds 512 sounds.

**New: Program Config.** Copy and Swap work with another program's pads (the wheel picks the program). SHIFT + wheel on Snd: (and Sample:) steps only through sounds in memory that no pad plays.

releases.body:
## Download

- **Windows** (64-bit): `Trackyard-Setup-1.2.0.exe`

Install over the old version; your songs, settings and downloaded models stay. The app isn't signed by a registered developer: see the [README](https://github.com/drose030/trackyard#or-the-app-for-mac-or-windows) for the first start.

## New: pad sounds for Beat-Train

Beat-Train can mute the drum stem and play a real drum sound on each pad strike instead. In the editor, the ♪ button right of each row picks that row's sound from the song's own drum stem:

- It steps through the row's hits (‹ › or ←/→), best first: as few other drums at the same time as possible, ringing out freely, no ghost notes. Each one plays, and the cut is marked in its row.
- **Use this** picks it, **No sound** removes it; undo works as for notes.
- Save writes the picks to `sounds/` in the song folder: `kick.wav`, `red.wav`, `yellow.wav`, `blue.wav`, `orange.wav`, `green.wav`, named after the row colours.

A sound starts 1 ms before the hit's attack in the drum stem, found to the sample, and lasts as long as the hit rings, up to the next hit. With pad sounds on, Beat-Train mutes the whole drum stem, so a pad without a sound stays silent. Songs without a drum stem can't get pad sounds.

releases.name: MPC Remote addin v1.4.1
releases.body:
**Installer update for MPC OS 3.10.1.** The addin is unchanged from 1.4.0; only the bundled installer is new (open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins at dbe1f2b).

- Fixes "Read-only file system" under `/etc/systemd/system/acvs.service.d/` when installing or updating on 3.10.1.
- **Gen1 with Akai's user access on (e.g. Key 37):** `/etc` is a read-only overlay stacked on a writable one; the drop-in is written in the writable layer and persists across reboots (open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins#834).
- **Gen2 (e.g. Live III):** `/etc` is read-only, so the addin loads through a `/run` drop-in. `/run` is cleared at every reboot; the **Addin Restore** patch (Plugin Manager → PATCHES) puts it back at start-up.

Already have Remote? Reinstall it (Plugin Manager or the installer app): an addin installed from an older release keeps its older installer.

---

The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files.

## Requirements

- A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else.
- **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit.
- Installing addins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk.

## Install

1. Unzip, then copy the whole folder to the device, e.g. `scp -r MPC-Remote-addin-1.4.1 root@<device-ip>:/tmp/`
2. Run it: `ssh root@<device-ip> sh /tmp/MPC-Remote-addin-1.4.1/install.sh`

The installer copies the addin into `/data/mpc-addins/remote/`, adds `mpc_remote_addin.so` to the `LD_PRELOAD` list of MPC's service
and **restarts MPC** (save your project first). The list is extended, never replaced: other addins and the
libraries the firmware preloads stay. Where no writable file sets the list (the unit is on the read-only root), one
drop-in shared by every addin sets it, `/etc/systemd/system/<service>.service.d/90-mpc-addins.conf`. Re-run the
installer after a firmware update. `-y` skips the question, `-n` leaves the restart to you.

Settings are in `/data/mpc-addins/remote/mpc_remote_addin.conf`; an upgrade keeps your edits.

It listens on the device only. From your computer: ssh -L 6720:127.0.0.1:6720 root@<device address>, then open http://localhost:6720 (bind and port are in mpc_remote_addin.conf).

Uninstalling and the file list are in `INSTALL.md` inside each zip.

releases.name: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.2.0
releases.body:
**MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.2.0.** Hold 16 Levels (about a second) to turn Scale on or off; with Scale on, the 16 Levels slots play a scale, shown on the SCALE page.

Changes since 1.1.0:
- **The page is Scale.** A hold turns Scale and the SCALE page on together, and the next hold turns both off: MPC's screen comes straight back (it used to linger a few seconds, and closing the page with the dial left Scale on). A dial press now exits Scale too. If another page took the screen while Scale is on, a hold brings the SCALE page back.
- **Input lock.** While Scale is on, buttons and knobs no longer reach MPC, so nothing changes MPC's screen or parameters under the page (before, the knobs moved the sample's trim and other settings). The pads, 16 Levels, Shift, the transport (Rec, Overdub, Stop, Play, Play Start), notes 84-87 and the page's own keys, dial and K1-K3 still work. `lock_input=0` turns the lock off; `pass_notes` lists the buttons that get through. Each control kept from MPC is logged with its note.
- `padctl raw [n]` logs the raw control-surface input to MPC's journal.

Checked on an MPC Sample, firmware 1.3.0.12 (2026-11-09): the hold toggle and the input lock, by hand and with injected presses. Notes 84-87 are believed to be the bank buttons; not confirmed yet.

Needs [mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler) **1.0.1** or later for the page. The installer's `LD_PRELOAD` drop-in on the Sample is on `/run`, so reinstall after a reboot (or restore it from the SD card's autorun).

releases.name: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.1.0
releases.body:
**MPC Sample Scale Mode** (was Enable Scale Mode). **Hold 16 Levels** (about a second) to turn Scale on or off. With Scale on, the 16 Levels slots play a scale instead of their usual steps. A short press is still a normal 16 Levels press, and Shift+16 Levels still cycles the Type.

![The SCALE page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-scalemode/7f5c90324dbc6f3458eb17466a265d5992d2fade/docs/screenshots/scale-page.png)

Holding 16 Levels also opens a **SCALE page**. It shows the notes every slot plays and lights the one you hit; the soft keys pick scale, root or octave, the dial changes it, K1-K3 set them directly, and a dial press closes it. It stays up while Scale is on.

Needs [mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler) **1.0.1** or later for the page. Without it, the hold still toggles Scale.

**Upgrading from Enable Scale Mode 0.x:** the addin was renamed, so uninstall the old one first: `sh /data/mpc-addins/enable-scalemode/uninstall.sh`. While the old one is loaded, this one stays off and says so in MPC's log. Settings start fresh.

Changes since 1.0.0:
- **Always by ear.** `detect_pitch=always` (or `padctl detect always`) listens to every sample, not only untagged ones, and the note heard wins over the file's tag: for samples tagged with the wrong note. Checked on a Moog lead tagged D that sounds C#: with root A, slot 0 sounded G# by the tag and A by ear. A sample with no clear pitch keeps MPC's root note either way.
- `detect_pitch` takes `untagged` (the default, as in 1.0.0), `always` or `off` (0/1/2 still work); `padctl detect` shows or sets it and saves it to the conf.

Tested on an MPC Sample, firmware 1.3.0.12 (2026-11-06): the device test passes 19 of 19 from this zip, with every slot's pitch and the pad latency measured from the USB audio. The installer's `LD_PRELOAD` drop-in on the Sample is on `/run`, so reinstall after a reboot.

releases.body:
# RHYTHMER OS 0.2.0
## New sounds. Better flow.

More sounds to explore, more direct editing, and a smoother path from your first note to a finished groove.

RHYTHMER OS 0.2.0 brings two new instruments, an updated FMini-1, refined Rhythmer Kit editing, and improvements throughout the track, Acid and Break workflows. Built for exploring Jungle, Techno, House and IDM on your MPC Sample.

### Meet your new instruments

- **Frodhes:** expressive electric pianos, vibraphone and marimba, with 57 original factory programs.
- **Tenebrae:** eight oscillator models spanning basses, leads, pads, keys and more, with 164 programs including Init.
- **FMini-1:** updated to the original 2.6.0 engine, with revised filter response, contour shaping and optimizations, retaining its 200 original factory presets.

### Start a track. Change direction.

TRACK SETUP brings instrument replacement, track types, MPC kit loading and track deletion into one visible menu. Change an instrument or track type while keeping your patterns; delete a track through its separate confirmation.

Press the encoder on an engine-less track to choose its type. On a Sample Kit, pressing it on an empty pad opens sample loading for that pad, including when the whole kit is empty. On-screen hints show the next step.

Change instruments directly from the preset list. Switch tracks while browsing and the screen follows the selected track. Preset browsing wraps from the last sound back to the first, in both directions.

B2 SENDS stays visible in BASIC. Its confirmation can enable FULL and open SENDS directly, or cancel without changing modes. Existing repeat-rate, MOVE/COPY and back controls retain their priority.

### Find a break. Keep the groove.

Browse loops with ORIGINAL or tempo-synchronised SYNC audition before loading them. Replacing a source preserves your existing patterns and performance settings, with clear confirmation when changing the source's bar count.

BREAK GEN and BRK PERF have clearer entry, return and loading controls. Pattern Hold, CHOP, LOOP and STRETCH have more explicit operating hints, while Variation and Stretch feedback show when the performance actions are active.

Loop audition remains separate from the track's musical state, so you can explore another source while keeping your current groove intact.

### Your pad. Your sound.

Rhythmer Kit's EDIT list starts with the selected pad's native **Volume**, followed by its supported Pan, Tune or Decay controls. Related parameters stay together in rows of three, with the whole-kit filter on the next row.

P01–P16 labels identify the pad you are editing; ALL PADS identifies the kit-wide filter. The 36 complete sixteen-pad factory kits retain their mixed-engine flexibility, pad-source replacement and User Kit saving.

Mute individual Rhythmer Kit pads with MUTE + pad, solo a pad with SHIFT + pad in mute mode, and clear project mutes with SHIFT + MUTE. Pad LEDs show the state, which is kept in the project without changing the kit's sound settings. TRACKS retains whole-track mute. Existing release and effect tails decay naturally.

### Shape it. Save it. Come back to it.

Parameter names and ordering are refined across oscillator, filter, envelope, LFO, modulation and effects controls. Source, Destination and Amount stay together, and named choices make settings such as Key Tracking and Polarity easier to read.

Open SAVE SOUND or PAD SOURCE from EDIT, save to one of 64 User Sound or User Kit slots, and reload your sounds from the preset list—even in another project. Save the project separately to keep its patterns and arrangement.

### Save where you choose

First SAVE and SAVE AS let you choose a folder and name. Further SAVE presses update that file. Opening another project or starting NEW offers SAVE, DISCARD or CANCEL instead of automatically overwriting your manual save.

Idle autosave updates one separate recovery entry per project under Rhythmer/Autosave. On the Project home screen, SHIFT + B3 RECOVERY opens the list; load a recovered copy and SAVE it deliberately.

### Build a chord progression

CHORD GEN is a separate instrument-track generator alongside the existing GENERATE Tn / MUTATE Tn workflow. Choose a genre, progression family, 1–8 chord changes and 1–16 bars; adjust rhythmic density, chord complexity, energy, voicing and register, then play the result as Block chords, an arpeggio or a strum.

It follows the project's key and scale by default. Local overrides affect only the generated part. Jazz and neo-soul profiles add extended harmony and voice leading. NEW CHORDS chooses another progression; MUTATE CHORDS keeps the progression while varying articulation. Generation keeps the instrument and other tracks, with Undo/Redo.

Rhythmer Kit retains genre-based drum generation; Acid and Break keep their dedicated generators. The illustrated manual and First Groove guide explain which command to use and how to return from each page.

### Acid, ready to play

Acid GEN keeps its NEW/MUTATE generation behavior while presenting its musical settings across two pages, without exposed seed controls.

Eight original Aphex choices join the Hortator Acid palette: **Acid Squelch, Lead Scream, Whistle Lead, Resonant Spike, Acid Seq, Reso Bass, Filter Cry and Techno Pulse**. Their native sound controls remain available for editing.

### Refinements

A steadier external MIDI BPM display keeps whole-number tempos clean while retaining meaningful fractional readings. The actual sync algorithm is unchanged. Rhythmer Kit animation flows across pad changes, and contextual Note Repeat and ARP controls remain available.

### Fixes

- Preset loading, parameter mapping, pad labels and state restoration.
- Track navigation, Back, confirmation, loading cancellation and Undo/Redo.
- Break playback, performance controls and held-command handling.
- User Sound/User Kit saving and error feedback.

### Make your first groove

The manual and **Your first groove with RHYTHMER OS.** guide cover the current navigation, track types, sound saving, independent Chord GEN and the Break workflow, with visual controls and step-by-step instructions.

[Download & Installation](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/installer/) · [Manual](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/manual/) · [Your first groove](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/manual/quickstart.html)

RHYTHMER OS remains early beta software. Back up your SD card before installing, follow the installation guide, and keep sharing what feels good and what could work better.

Built on Melodee by Kerem Kiliç / Ellic Studio, with thanks to the original engine developers and open-source contributors. Original authorship, licenses and credits are retained.

**RHYTHMER OS — by Jazzy Rhythmer**

*In search of feel-good rhythms.*

releases.body:
RHYTHMER OS for MPC Sample — 0.2.0-beta.3.

The release version is **0.2.0-beta.3**. Use the **full SD ZIP** for installation; it includes the app and matching preset catalogue. Back up your card and preserve your own projects, presets and recordings. A same-version UPDATE is not automatically offered by the native updater.

## Workflow

- On native Sample Kit SOUND/TRIM, encoder Push opens TRACK TYPE if all 128 pads and layers are empty. SAMPLE KIT starts first-sample loading. If other pads contain samples, Push opens SAMPLES for the selected empty pad. Screen hints show both routes.
- Loaded/layered pads, other editors, recording/Freeze guards, Break loop entry and contextual Note Repeat controls keep their existing jobs. Shift + Push cancels the browser; B1 goes up folders or exits at the root. Sample load Undo preserves other pads.
- Preset lists and main PRESETS browsing wrap in both directions using the encoder or Minus/Plus. Folder lists wrap within the current folder. User Sound/User Kit remain included; absolute pot selection and existing load timing are unchanged.

## Acid Engine

The four original Hortator Acid sounds are retained. Eight unmodified Aphex factory choices are also available: **Acid Squelch, Lead Scream, Whistle Lead, Resonant Spike, Acid Seq, Reso Bass, Filter Cry and Techno Pulse**. They use the original Aphex DSP, native filters and source edit parameters. Source identity and edits persist in projects and User Sound; Rhythmer Kit pad source/restore is also covered.

## Validation

ARM64 build; 19 runtime unit tests; 290 track/input/navigation assertions; GEN/Acid/Break integration; audio self-test; 36,000 random surface moves; 430 UI previews with no text issues. Host regressions cover single instruments, 36 kits, engine/kit filters and 4,587 control round trips. All eight aliases match original Aphex control values and pass five-note output, project/User Sound and pad-source restore checks under ASan/UBSan for the host code. Original native DSP libraries are unchanged and not all are sanitizer-instrumented. Signed-update identity and tamper checks pass.

This is early beta software.  No break recordings are bundled.

releases.body:
RHYTHMER OS for MPC Sample — 0.2.0-beta.3 / Break workflow hotfix.2.

The release version is **0.2.0-beta.3**. This separate release record identifies the matching installation files and corresponding source. The Sound / Kit save hotfix is included.

## Break: load, find the controls, play

- Loading or reloading source A makes a straight sixteen-chop pattern and stays in **BREAK GEN**, with **BRK PERF** selected. Push / B3 OPEN enters the performance pages.
- While decoding, **B1 CANCEL** or **SHIFT + encoder Push** cancels track assignment. Other generator actions and knob cards wait until loading finishes. A cached decoded file may remain; a cancelled request cannot replace the track.
- Source A/B completion does not reopen a dismissed menu or pull you away from another track. Replacing/deleting the target track continues to invalidate pending loads.
- Reopen controls from the Break track: **SEQ / PATTERNS → SHIFT + B3 GEN → BREAK GEN → BRK PERF**. In BRK PERF, B1 GEN returns to BREAK GEN. BACK / Shift + Push returns to main GEN, then closes it.
- **Pattern Hold** replaces the misleading LOOP HOLD label. It holds the internal generated pattern in LOOP mode, not audio sustain or track Freeze. The stored parameter and DSP behavior are unchanged. CHOP mode and zero variation can make the difference inaudible.
- Grain / Splice / Slow explicitly describe stretched hits. With playback running, hold Pad 3 STRETCH on ROLLS, keep it held while paging to GRAIN, adjust the controls and release; recorded STRETCH works too. Pattern Hold is not required.
- Rejected/undecodable files return to the owned browser for retry without replacing the previous instrument. A track frozen during decoding cancels assignment without a late Unfreeze dialog.
- All six pages have clearer operating hints. SOURCE B requires a loaded B file; TRACK MIX changes the track mix rather than generating a pattern. RETURN clears Variation/Drift while keeping the selected A/B source.
- General GEN also saves the Acid RNG stream with its Undo/Redo operation, keeping the generated notes and random state together. The generation algorithm and seed policy are unchanged.

## Install and learn

Use the **full SD ZIP**, verify its SHA-256 and back up the entire card first. The signed UPDATE ZIP is app-only and is not a first-install package; the native updater may not offer a same-version hotfix. Target: MPC Sample AC50 / stock firmware 1.3.0.12. No break recordings are bundled.

[Download & installation](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/installer/) · [Break navigation and six-page guide](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/manual/#break-performance) · [Your first groove](https://jazzyrhythmer.github.io/mpc-sample/manual/quickstart.html#break-load)

The written manual and first-groove guide now match this hotfix. The existing tutorial film predates the load/menu change; its music and edited arrangement remain examples. Follow the current written navigation when screens differ. Random generation does not reproduce the edited example exactly.

## Validation scope

Software checks cover cancellation, A/B async ownership, current-track navigation, Undo/Redo, project save/reload, held STRETCH release after paging, CHOP/LOOP pattern hold, grain processing, existing track workflows, runtime tests, audio self-test, random surface inputs and native UI text/layout. Exact results and source identity are recorded in the validation receipt. Current software results: 19 runtime tests, 161 track-workflow assertions, three final fresh-process GEN/Acid/Break passes, 430 standard UI states with zero reported text issues, 12 × 3,000 random surface inputs, 16 original roll commands and 2,400 Acid reference cases. All 41 plug-in binaries and eight sample files are unchanged. Engine DSP, preset banks and serialized control IDs remain unchanged from the prior reviewed hotfix. Signatures, archive checksums and corresponding-source files are checked before publication.

releases.name: MPCTRACKER 0.1.0
releases.body:
First release of MPCTRACKER, a pattern tracker for the Akai MPC Sample that runs from an SD card.

It has eight tracks and 64 sample slots, and it uses the ProTracker effect column. It loads WAV files and 4 to 8 channel .mod files, saves songs to the card, and starts with a short VHS style intro that any pad skips. The README has the full list of controls.

## Installing

1. Read the Safety section of the README, save the project that is open on the sampler and back up the card.
2. Unzip `mpctracker-v0.1.0-sd-card.zip` and copy the `autorun` and `tracker` folders to the root of the SD card. This replaces any `autorun` folder that is already on the card.
3. Put WAV files in `tracker/samples`, or browse to samples that are already on the card.
4. Insert the card. The tracker starts a few seconds after the sampler has booted.
5. Hold SHIFT and press STOP to quit back to the sampler. Take the card out and power cycle for a normal boot.

## Notes

This was developed against the emulator on firmware 1.3.0.12. It starts and plays sound on a real unit, but most of the hardware testing is still to do, so expect rough edges. It never touches the sampler's internal storage and it only writes inside the `tracker` folder on the card.

The zip has no demo song. A first run plays a built-in drum kit and groove. Copy a `.mod` file into `tracker/songs` before the first start and it opens that instead.

Still to come are sampling from the inputs, block copy and paste, a fill tool, naming songs on the device, a view of all eight tracks at once, and MIDI.

releases.name: Melodee 0.5.1
releases.body:
Melodee 0.5.1 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

## Update

- **From 0.2.x to 0.5.0:** copy `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.5.1.zip` to the card, or send it from the web page at http://melodee.local. Melodee asks *Update to v0.5.1?*, saves, installs and restarts.
- **From 0.1.0 or a new card:** install by hand as in [Install](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample#install): unzip and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of the card.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**.

Back up `Melodee/Projects` before you update.

## Changed: read this first

- **Hold SEQ for the selected track's patterns.** On any page, a pad launches that pattern on the selected track only, and more pads in the same hold chain them. **SHIFT** + pad launches a sequence on every track. While **SHIFT** is held, the pads and the sheet show the sequences, and **SHIFT** + more pads chain them. **−** / **+** launch the previous / next pattern. A tap of **SEQ** still opens **Sequences**.
- **Auto chop cuts DRUMS and MUSIC on the beats.** A sample with a steady beat is cut on the beats Melodee finds in it: every 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 beats, or eighths, whichever comes nearest **SLICES**. No slice is shorter than 80 % of an eighth note, and Auto keeps its cuts that far from your hand cuts. HITS keeps 150 ms between cuts.

## New

### Chop

- **TO PADS writes a pattern of the slices.** With the **PATTERN** card on (the default), TO PADS also writes a pattern with a note for each slice where it falls, so **PLAY** gives you the loop back on pads you can change. With KIT, each note plays the pad of its sound. The pattern goes into the track's pattern when that is empty, else into the first empty one. Undo takes back the pads and the pattern in one step.

### Settings

- **USB volume** on **AUDIO**: what a computer records from the MPC over USB-C. **Full** (the default) sends the mix at full level whatever **MAIN VOLUME** is set to. **Knob** follows **MAIN VOLUME**, as the jacks do.

## Fixed

- While a loop or MIDI track uses the mic or the rear inputs, the other input as Input Config's or an audio track's source shows **IN USE** and is silent, instead of playing the input in use under its name. Sample Record and audio takes refuse with a notice.

releases.name: Melodee 0.5.0
releases.body:
Melodee 0.5.0 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

## Update

- **From 0.2.x, 0.3.0 or 0.4.0:** copy `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.5.0.zip` to the card, or send it from the web page at http://melodee.local. Melodee asks *Update to v0.5.0?*, saves, installs and restarts.
- **From 0.1.0 or a new card:** install by hand as in [Install](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample#install): unzip and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of the card.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**.

Back up `Melodee/Projects` before you update.

## Changed: read this first

- **Settings and MIDI Config rows are set with K1.** The encoder picks a row, **K1** sets it (its card shows the value), **−** / **+** step it. Push no longer opens a value. Sample rate, Audio buffer and Screen Mirror wait until K1 rests before the device reopens.
- **Chop opens on the type you picked last.** A sample with no slices opens on the last **K3** type, kept with the settings.

## New

### Sequencing

- **Free pattern length.** An empty pattern is Free: **K1** shows *Free*. The first Seq Record take grows it a bar at a time and ends at the bar line when you press **SEQ RECORD** or **STOP**. With notes on other tracks in its sequence, the take gets their length. Up to 128 bars.
- **Step Edit: a new bar past the end.** The cursor walks past the last step into a new bar, marked by a **+** and an arrow at the right edge. A step written there makes the pattern long enough to hold it, to the end of its bar. Left empty, nothing changes.

### Chop

- **Auto** chop type (**K3**). Melodee reads the sample as DRUMS, MUSIC, SHOTS or HITS, shown at the top right, and cuts to suit:
  - DRUMS: one slice a drum hit. Ghost notes and flams stay with the hit before.
  - MUSIC: where the chords change.
  - SHOTS: one slice a sound between silences.
  - HITS: the strongest hits, spread out.
  
  **SHIFT** + **K3** sets SLICES, 8 to 64.
- **B2** (**CLEAN**) on Auto separates the sample's stems once and cuts on the DRUMS stem.
- **TO PADS** has a fourth card, **KIT**: one pad a sound, kicks first. Slices that sound the same share one pad (the longest one) and the hats share a mute group.

### Auto sampler

- Up to **8 velocity layers**: **LAYERS** Auto or 1–8. Auto splits where the tone changes; the sheet shows the layers as VEL bars. The .xpm keeps 4 layers for MPC 2, and the keygroup track plays all of them from the .xty.
- A WAV is written mono when both sides are the same.
- **TIME** shows about how long sampling takes, before you press **SAMPLE**.
- **STEP** goes up to 24 semitones, **HOLD** up to 20 s.

### Plug-ins

- Replacing a plug-in on a track is one undo step. Undo loads the old plug-in with its state; redo brings back the new one.

### Settings

- **USAGE LOG** (**K2** on the Settings doors, off at first). While on, Melodee writes pages opened, presses and turns that changed nothing, undo soon after an edit, MENU picks and lesson steps to `Melodee/Usage`. No project, sample or plug-in names.

## Fixed

- Recall fills the pattern a track plays when that pattern is empty, so a jam in a new project lands in P1, not P2.
- Auto sample on a MIDI track no longer shows the SPEED readout: an outside instrument plays in real time.

releases.name: Melodee 0.4.0
releases.body:
Melodee 0.4.0 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

## Update

- **From 0.2.x or 0.3.0:** copy `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.4.0.zip` to the card, or send it from the web page at http://melodee.local. Melodee asks *Update to v0.4.0?*, saves, installs and restarts.
- **From 0.1.0 or a new card:** install by hand as in [Install](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample#install): unzip and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of the card.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**.

Back up `Melodee/Projects` before you update.

## Changed: read this first

- **Chop is reworked.** See *Chop* below. The encoder now moves the selected slice's cut instead of selecting a slice: tap a slice's pad or use **−** / **+** to select one. Push no longer starts a Manual take. **B2** (**SNAP**) is gone: every cut always lands on a zero crossing.
- **Rec Quantize is one press.** **SHIFT** + **Pad 10** turns it on or off, as on the MPC. Recorded notes land on the pattern's Q. The REC QUANTIZE page and Settings' Rec grid row are gone.
- **A new project has no tracks.** The track types open on track 1. On the NEW question, **B2** (**KIT**) starts with the MPC's factory kit on track 1.
- **Melodee starts on Full**, also after an update. Basic offers every track type.
- **Nothing is written to the card's top level.** New samples go to `Melodee/Samples` and `.syx` files are read from `Melodee/SysEx`. The old `Samples` and `SysEx` folders at the top are still read.
- **Push on an MPC drum program** in the sample browser opens **LOAD KIT** instead of replacing the kit at once (see below).
- **ERASE + an empty pad** on a kit now closes the gap (see below).
- **The meter lights** step as the stock app's: −24.1, −12.1, −6.1 and −3.1 dBFS, red past −0.1 dBFS.
- **The manual** is updated for all of this, on GitHub and on the web page at http://melodee.local.

## New

### Chop

- **Manual take with the red pad.** Set **K3** to Manual. Pad 1 blinks red: tap it and the region plays. The red moves to the next pad; tap it on the next hit to cut there. After pad 16 the pads turn to bank B, up to 64 slices in banks A–D. Tap a lit pad to play again from its slice and redo the cuts after it. A take is one undo step.
- **Fix a cut by eye.** Tap a slice's pad and turn the encoder: its start moves (its end after **K2**). The view zooms in while you turn and the slice plays once when you stop. **SHIFT** + encoder jumps the cut from hit to hit, marked under the waveform.
- **PAD BANK** steps the pads through the slices, 16 at a time.
- **Beats chop by division:** 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2 or 4 bars on **SHIFT** + **K3**.
- **Cuts you make or move by hand stay** when you chop again by type, threshold, division or regions. An automatic cut close to one of yours gives way to it, so no short slivers.
- **ERASE + pad** joins a slice with the one before. On pad 1 it joins with the next. The pads after move down one. **ERASE** + **CHOP** takes every cut out.
- **TO PADS** asks how the slices play: **POLY**, **MONO** (one mute group) or **THRU** (each plays on to the region's end).
- The chop type, its amount and your hand cuts are saved in the sample's WAV file with its slices, so they are still there after a restart.

### Kits

- **LOAD KIT.** Push on an MPC drum program in the sample browser shows its filled banks and how many pads each has. Pick which of your kit's banks each one fills, or **WHOLE KIT**. Only the filled pads are loaded; the rest of your kit stays. One undo.
- **Close a gap.** **ERASE** + an empty pad moves the pads after it down one, with their notes, through that bank and the next one. To take a pad out and close the gap, press **ERASE** + that pad twice. The notices say what happened.

### Samples

- **A sample's note is found** when it loads or is recorded. 16 Levels Scale and Chords, MIDI into 16 Levels, Roll's row names and a keygroup track of one sample play from that note instead of C. A chord stab's root is found from its chord.
- **Stems BEST** (**B2**): separates up to 16 kHz in two passes, about three times as long. On at first, kept with the settings.
- The sample browser's **PREVIEW** works on a keygroup track too, and stays on or off after a restart.

### Sequencing

- **Roll:** **K2** on marked notes moves their velocities together.

## Fixed

- A kept punch ends with its pattern, also with Half Seq, a shorter length, Half Speed or an editor's loop. Punches let go when the transport leaves them.
- Motion and kept punches past a pattern's end stay out on a track at another speed.
- A kit lane of its own length keeps its notes with Seq Record, Note Repeat and Time Correct.
- Stopping before the bar a launched sequence waits for brings its tempo with it.
- The song's clips play their pattern where the song is.
- A track move takes its kept punches and its modulator and macro lanes with it.
- An editor's loop plays the right bars on a track at another speed.
- Clear pattern takes the pattern's Motion with its notes.
- **SHIFT** + **PLAY** continues from the right place on a track at another speed.
- A MIDI track's audio no longer clicks on each pad touch and release.
- The auto sampler no longer hears an outside instrument's check notes ringing.

releases.name: sample-base v0.1.0 — demos proof of concept (no SSH)
releases.body:
A proof of concept of sample-base's demos that starts from the microSD card: no computer, SSH or network connection needed.

**Requires MPC Sample firmware 1.3.0.12 exactly.** On anything else the demos do not start and the stock app keeps running.

### Install
1. Back up the card. Move any existing top-level `autorun` folder (MPC Sample Plugins, Melodee) somewhere safe: this one replaces it.
2. Copy the `autorun` folder from the zip to the top level of the card. Don't edit or rename anything inside: the MPC refuses an autorun whose files changed.
3. Switch the MPC on. The stock app starts first; a few seconds later the demos take over the screen.

**Push the wheel** to go back to stock until the next boot. Delete the `autorun` folder to uninstall. A crash or failed start also brings stock back; nothing on the MPC itself changes, only the card.

### What's in it
- Pads play a 16-voice sine/triangle synth in C major; external MIDI plays it too
- **Sample**: record Line in, Mic or USB-C for up to 60 s and play it back
- **Pad FX**: a light show over every LED on the surface
- **16 Levels**: pad velocity and pressure
- **SEQ**: eight-drum, sixteen-step sequencer
- **Knob FX**: live system dashboard

### Files
`sample-base-demos-MPC-Sample-v0.1.0.zip`, SHA256 `d338960d4eb3b8d9129b7ba3e513fe1fbda6d455081a00d21ddb0003ca576652` (also in the `.sha256` asset). Built from 34f8fc7. AGPL-3.0-only, JUCE under AGPLv3; licences are in the zip. Not affiliated with inMusic or Akai Professional.

releases.name: SampleBoot 1.0.2
releases.body:
One card, every OS: a boot selector for the Akai MPC Sample. Website: https://sampleboot.com

## Added

- **`sampleboot.inplace`.** An empty file with this name in a system's folder makes SampleBoot run it from `autorun/` itself, as if it were alone on the card. For systems that take "the folder above their own" for the card. **MPCTRACKER 0.1.0 needs it**: without it, its file browser stays inside `autorun/mods/` and it looks for its songs and samples there.
- **Boot history.** `autorun/sampleboot/boot-history.log` keeps the logs of the last 10 boots, each headed by its date, to compare tests. `BOOT_HISTORY` in `sampleboot.conf` sets how many (0 = none).
- **[Notes for OS authors](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot/blob/main/docs/OS-AUTHORS.md):** how to make a system that runs from SampleBoot exactly as it runs on its own.

## Fixed

- The last line of `last-boot.log` could be missing when the card was read from a computer through SD card access without a restart. It is now written to the card at once.

## Works with

Firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12) with SampQOL OS 0.1.4.7 to 0.3.0, Melodee 0.1.0 to 0.3.0, MPC Simple 1.0 Beta 1 to Beta 3 and MPCTRACKER 0.1.0 (tested), ODDFORM 1.2.0 beta (reported by a user). See the [list](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot#works-with).

## Updating

Copy the `autorun` folder from the zip over the one on your card (your systems in `autorun/mods/` stay), or run `tools/add_mod.py` with your card's path to keep your settings too. A `sampleboot.conf` from 1.0.x works as it is.

releases.name: SampleBoot 1.0.1
releases.body:
One card, every OS: a boot selector for the Akai MPC Sample.

## Fixed

- **SampQOL OS 0.3.0's 16 USB audio outputs now work when SampQOL is started from SampleBoot.** SampQOL keeps its settings in `mpcqol.conf` at the card root, but its start script reads them from the folder above its own, which under SampleBoot is `autorun/mods/`. SampleBoot now shows the card root's `mpcqol.conf` in `autorun/mods/` too (a bind mount of that one file, until power-off), so SampQOL reads its real settings. The first time, a copy of the file is left in `autorun/mods/`: that's expected.

## Added

- `ROOT_FILES` setting in `sampleboot.conf`: the settings files to show in `autorun/mods/` this way. Default `"mpcqol.conf"`.

## Tested

Firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12) with Melodee 0.1.0 to 0.3.0, SampQOL OS 0.1.4.7 to 0.3.0 and MPC Simple 1.0 Beta 1 and Beta 2.

## Updating from 1.0.0

Copy the `autorun` folder from the zip over the one on your card (your systems in `autorun/mods/` stay), or run `tools/add_mod.py` with your card's path to keep your settings. A `sampleboot.conf` from 1.0.0 works as it is: the default applies.

Thanks to the user who reported the missing USB outputs!

releases.name: SampleBoot 1.0.0
releases.body:
**One card, every OS.** SampleBoot is a boot menu for the Akai MPC Sample: the stock firmware and every custom OS (Melodee, SampQOL OS, MPC Simple, …), in as many versions as you like, live on the same SD card. Turn the encoder, push it, and the system you chose starts. No more swapping cards or moving `autorun` folders around.

Tested on firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12). SampleBoot changes nothing on the MPC: without the card, it starts as stock. **Back up your SD card before installing.**

### Install
1. Download `SampleBoot-1.0.0.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Copy its `autorun` folder to the top level of the SD card.
3. Copy each OS's own `autorun` folder into `autorun/mods/` and rename it, e.g. `autorun/mods/Melodee 0.2.2/`.

Full instructions in the [README](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot#install).

### In this release
- Splash screen drawn line by line (dark, light, your own or off), then a full-screen boot menu with each system's image, encoder control, countdown with beeps that follow the Main Volume knob, switch-off from POWER
- Switches off the pad and button lights left on by the previous app
- Add an OS by copying a folder; several versions side by side; custom name and image per system
- Falls back to the stock app if a system does not start; restores every audio setting it touches
- Every colour configurable in `sampleboot.conf`, plus `tools/theme-editor.html`, an offline page that previews every screen exactly as the MPC draws it
- `tools/add_mod.py`, an optional helper that adds OSes straight from their release zips

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for everything.

SampleBoot ships no custom OS: download them from their own projects. Not affiliated with inMusic Brands or Akai Professional.

releases.name: MaiaOS - Beta V2
releases.body:
MaiaOS V2 for MPC Sample

MaiaOS V2 adds a horizontal Song timeline, stereo Master and experimental Stems export, external plug-in support, and two-deck DJ Mode. It runs from an exFAT microSD on MPC Sample with stock firmware 1.3.0.12. It requires no internal installation or SSH setup.

What's new

Song timeline and export — Arrange named sequences on a horizontal timeline and follow the playhead during playback. Open Song with Shift + Pad 12, then press B1 for Song Export. Choose Master for a stereo WAV or Stems for separate WAVs for Drums, Bass, Synths, and Melody Samples. Review and change pad assignments before rendering. Press the encoder in the main Song Export menu to combine the song into one editable MPC sequence. Audio exports go to the card's Export/ folder.

External plug-ins — Import VST2, VST3, LV2, and CLAP builds for Linux AArch64 as instruments or effects. The encoder switches parameter pages. Hold Shift for additional controls on supported pages. Instrument plug-ins work with 16 Levels and Chord Mode.

External MIDI — Play the selected sample or instrument pad chromatically, even with 16 Levels closed. REC and OVERDUB capture pitch, velocity, and note duration on that pad.

Sound editing — Three-band EQ and a spectrum display are available for samples, synths, Multisamples, and instrument plug-ins. For a sample pad, open Filter and press the encoder. Instrument screens have an oscilloscope, and Knob FX labels and values are larger.

DJ Mode — Load two decks with scrolling beatgrids, tempo sync, nudge, and loops. Press Sequence to choose stereo master on OUT 1/2 with stereo USB cue, or mono master on OUT 1 with mono cue on OUT 2. Pad FX works while the decks play. Flex Beat stays bypassed, and leaving DJ Mode requires confirmation.

Fixes

Switching pads closes the EQ editor and preserves each pad's settings. Returning to the original pad restores normal encoder navigation.

FIX: The microSD launcher and file browsers follow the mounted card when its volume is renamed.

Install from microSD

Extract the V2 ZIP and copy the entire autorun folder to the root of an exFAT microSD. The volume can have any name.

Power off the MPC, insert the card, and power on. When updating from an earlier build, replace the entire autorun folder.

To return to stock firmware, power off, remove the card, and power on again.

If startup fails, keep autorun/maia-boot.log if it was created. Use a fresh copy of autorun before retrying.

Known limitations

Stems export is experimental. Separate renders may differ from the full master, especially with compression, limiting, saturation, or sidechain processing. Audition the four WAVs before using them in another project.

External plug-ins are session-based. Reopening a project requires reloading the plug-ins and setting their parameters again.


The external plug-in host is based on Melodee by Kerem Kilic (Ellic Studio).

Use at your own risk, the developer decline any reponsibility over failed installation/crashes/bricks

releases.name: SampQOL OS 0.3.0 (beta)
releases.body:
SampQOL OS is a free mod for the MPC Sample firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12). It starts from the SD card and does not change the stock firmware. With the SD card in, it starts by itself. Without the SD card, the MPC starts as stock 1.3.0.

Tested only with MPC Sample 1.3.0. MPC One, Live and X are not tested yet. This is beta software: back up your projects first. A failed project load can delete samples (see the manual, "Project safety net").

## New in 0.3.0

- Key detection in the Tuner: B2 Key shows the key of the sample on the selected pad, for example "A min". B3 Apply saves it as the key of the sample. The key goes into the project and the WAV file.
- Auto Key: a new sample from Sample Select, Sample Record or Resample gets its key at once. On or off in Settings.
- Sample key by hand: SAMPLE, Tune page, SHIFT + K2 (Key).
- Tuner K2 / K3: set the tune (Semi / Fine) of the selected pad while you read its note.
- Delete Folder: delete a folder on the SD card, with all files in it, from the MPC. SAMPLE SELECT, External, select a folder, SHIFT + B3. The MPC asks first. A folder with the loaded project cannot be deleted.
- Screen Mirror: see the MPC screen live in a browser on your computer, for tutorials and videos. Connect the USB cable and open http://mpc-sample.local:7410. Nothing to set up.
- Effects on the input: put up to 3 insert effects on what you record, for example a compressor or a filter on a synth at the rear input. What you hear on the input is what you record. SAMPLE RECORD, SHIFT + B2 opens the new Input FX page. Before, only the Knob FX could go on the input.
- Sleep (Settings): after 5 to 30 minutes with no input, the screen and all pad and button lights go off, to save the battery. Any button, pad or knob wakes the MPC, and that first touch does nothing else. The MPC does not sleep while it plays or records.
- Input strip in the Ch. Mixer: the far left strip sets the input volume (K1 or the FADER) and shows the input level. The volume is in the monitor and in the recording. SHIFT + B1 (Inserts) opens the Input FX page, and B1 (Back) brings you back to the Ch. Mixer.
- Mixer: hold ERASE and move a control to erase its recorded automation in this sequence: volume, pan or mute in the Ch. Mixer and Pad Mixer, effect on/off and effect knobs on the insert and effect pages. All erases all automation of that track, submix or pad.
- Load Kit loads the samples of a drum program (.xpm) from the MPC software or an MPC Live, One or X into the current track. Only the samples: not the insert effects, not the effect settings and not the pad settings.
- Two more insert effects. AIR Lo-Fi (group Harmonic) makes a sound lo-fi: bit depth, sample rate and clip. AIR Pitch Shifter (group Modulation) changes the pitch of a pad, track, submix or the master and keeps the length (Tune changes both).
- 16 USB Outputs (Settings): the MPC sends tracks and submixes to a computer on 16 more USB audio channels (USB 3-18), as separate outputs in your DAW. Select USB 3 to USB 18 (mono) or a pair with K3 (Out) in the Mixer. A + after the output (USB 5+) shows that another track or submix also plays on it. The setting applies after a restart.
- Step Edit: SHIFT + PLAY with no selection and no loop can start at the cursor, not at the playhead (Settings "Shift+Play Starts").
- Settings: Tap Tempo Light. Blink makes the TAP TEMPO light flash with the tempo, as stock. Dimmed (default) keeps it on, a little dimmed.
- Settings: Pad View Order and Track View Order put pad 1 or track 1 at the top (default) or at the bottom, as on the pads.

## Changed in 0.3.0

- B3 works differently while the KNOB FX bar shows: B3 now turns the Knob FX on or off (Bypass), on every screen (also PAD FX and the Tuner). Orange frame = on, orange box = off. Before, B3 did the function of the screen under the bar (for example Looper on SAMPLE RECORD). SHIFT + B3 still does that function. This is on by default. To get the old B3 back: Settings > Knob FX B3 Bypass > Off.
- STOP two times ends the SHIFT + PLAY loop, as PLAY does.
- Pad effects record automation: with SEQ RECORD + PLAY, the knobs on the effect page of a pad effect record their moves, as on a track or a submix. ERASE + knob on that page erases them. Before, a pad effect recorded nothing.
- Root note for KEYS moved to the Tune page of SAMPLE: SHIFT + K1 (Root), next to the new Key (SHIFT + K2). SHIFT + K1 on the Play page is stock Mono/Poly again.
- Stock key guess off: stock guessed a key for every sample on each load, mostly wrong and also on drum hits. A loaded sample keeps the key of its file. A new sample gets its key from Auto Key; set or detect a key with the Tuner or on the Tune page.
- 16 LEVELS: SAMPLE sets 16 Levels off and gives back the normal pads. Before, SAMPLE did nothing in 16 Levels (stock).
- Pad View: a small + on a note shows two or more notes of that pad in one cell, for example a double note at the loop end after a recording. ERASE at the cursor then clears them one by one, and the note that is most on time stays.
- SHIFT + PAD BANK: the track grid shows after 0.3 seconds, as the sequence grid. A quick tap (one pad bank back) shows no grid.
- Rec Quantize strength: the Rec Quantize popup (SHIFT + PAD 10) sets the strength on K2 (Q Str, 0-100). Below 100, a recorded note moves only part of the way to the grid. The project keeps the value. Time Correct always uses 100.
- 16 Levels Scale: while a Chord plays, the pad stays in Poly, so you hear all tones. Before, a Mono pad played only one tone of the chord.
- Looper: while you record, you hear the passes that you already recorded. Before, you heard only the input and recorded "blind".
- Looper: record again on the same pad, and the new take goes on top of the old loop as a new layer. Before, the new take replaced the old loop. One Undo removes only the last layer. With Looper off, a new take replaces the old loop, as before.
- Looper: the loop starts on the start of the sequence loop, also when you started to record in the middle. Thus a play from the start has the full loop in the first pass.
- Looper: a tap on another pad stops the take, as a tap on its own pad. Before, it chopped the take, and the passes were not merged.
- Projects go to the SD card by default: Settings PROJECT Start Drive is External. A project on the SD card keeps the internal storage free. If you changed Settings before, your Start Drive stays.
- SAMPLE RECORD: SHIFT + B2 now opens the Input FX page. Before, it set Rec Input Effects on or off. The Knob FX no longer plays on the input: you hear and record only the effects that you put on the Input FX page. Rec Input Effects in the stock Input Config menu does nothing. B2 on the page turns all input effects on or off (Input FX On or Off). Off = you hear and record the input dry.
- COPY (SHIFT + ERASE) to one pad that has a sample, on the same track or on another track: you can also swap the two pads (B2 Swap). The notes stay on their pads.
- The erase windows (ERASE + knob, fader or pad) show "No automation to erase." when there is nothing to erase. Stock showed nothing.
- The erase window tells what it erases: ERASE PAD AUTOMATION, ERASE TRACK AUTOMATION or ERASE SUBMIX AUTOMATION.
- The Ch. Mixer sets the MIDI channel of a track too (SHIFT + K3 on a track strip), as the Track page.
- A muted track or pad also sends no MIDI notes. With Mute Type Audio, a MIDI note that sounds stops when you mute.
- A track with its own MIDI channel follows Pad MIDI Out in MIDI Config (Always, When Empty, Never). Before, all its pads always sent MIDI, so the pads with a sample also played the external synth. After the update from 0.2.0, your synth can follow the tempo but play no notes: then Pad MIDI Out is When Empty or Never. Set it to Always (the stock default) and all pads send MIDI again.
- Chop Mode opens at once on a sample without chops, also on a long sample: the Chop Type is Manual, with one slice. Stock starts a Threshold chop there, and that takes long. For an auto chop, turn K3 to Threshold or Regions.
- Settings: Shift+SEQ is a Shortcuts line. It opens the Track View (default), the Pad View or another screen.
- Settings: Shift+PAD FX has a third choice, Last Used. SHIFT + PAD FX then opens the screen that you used last: Flex Beat or Pad FX.
- Settings: SHIFT + ENCODER goes from group to group, so you find a setting faster in the long list.
- Pad Mixer: a pad strip shows the pad colour that you give it with Rename. A pad without its own colour stays white.
- Pad View and Track View show 1 to 16 rows (Settings: Pad View Rows, Track View Rows). The FADER zooms the view: up = fewer, bigger rows (Fader Overrides: Pad / Track View = Zoom, the default for a new install).
- Fader Overrides: one page sets what the FADER does in Sample Select and Load Project (Scroll), in Pad View and Track View (Nudge or Zoom) and in Pad FX with Fixed on (Effect Mix). Fader Menu: the FADER does what you set in the FADER menu. Open it with B2 in the FADER menu, or in Settings (SYSTEM). It replaces the setting Fader Scrolls List. Your saved choices stay.
- Automate: a filter fade on many tracks can use one filter on a submix in place of one filter per track. The filter comes only at Do It!.
- The USB audio output to a computer is about 5 ms later than before (all USB channels). This prevents short gaps of silence. Your DAW does not know this delay: if a recording from the MPC is late, set a recording offset in the DAW.

## Fixed in 0.3.0

- Tuner: SHIFT + PAD 7 shows the note and cents of the mic, the rear input, the USB audio or the MPC output (Resample). The last note stays in grey. Apply sets the played note as the KEYS root note of the pad (shown on the screen), with every source. SHIFT + PAD 7 was Double Speed: set it back in Settings > Shortcuts.
- Input monitor without the Knob FX: with Rec Input Effects (Input FX) Off you hear the input dry. With On you hear the Knob FX one time, as in the recording. A change of Monitor (Off, Auto, On) fades, with no click.
- Source "Rear+USB": record and monitor the rear inputs and the USB audio from a computer at the same time. No more switching between them. In Sample Record (K1), Input Config and the Tuner.
- Insert FX list: 4 more effects. Dynamics has AIR Compressor, Mother Ducker and Mother Ducker Input. Modulation has AIR Stereo Width.
- Mother Ducker: put Mother Ducker Input on the sound that controls it (for example the kick) and Mother Ducker on the sound that gets softer (for example the bass). Set the same Bus (1-8) on both. Effect page: K1 Bus, K2 Threshold, K3 Ratio; SHIFT: Attack, Release, Soft Knee. The Mother Ducker only makes the sound softer: it adds no level. The effect page shows the other part on the same bus, for example "Input: A01 Kick" or "No Input on Bus 2". The Mother Ducker page also shows its gain reduction ("GR -10" and an orange bar).
- AIR Compressor starts neutral (0 dB, 1:1). Effect page: K1 Threshold, K2 Ratio, K3 Mix; SHIFT: Attack, Release, Output.
- AIR Stereo Width: K1 Width, K2 Level Trim, K3 Pan Trim; SHIFT: Low, Mid, High.
- Knob FX: hold KNOB FX and turn the ENCODER to change the effect on the screen you are on. The effect changes when you release KNOB FX, with a short fade and no click. A short push of KNOB FX sets Knob FX mode on or off when you release it.
- Fine-tune an effect with the ENCODER: open an insert effect in the Mixer (for example a Reverb on a pad) and turn K1, K2 or K3. Then the ENCODER changes that knob in small steps. Push the ENCODER to go to the next knob (SHIFT + push: the previous knob). This also works on the EQ page, the Tail page, the Scale bar and the Kill EQ page. Before, the ENCODER did nothing on an effect page.
- EQ page: SHIFT + B3 = Bypass. All pads play without the EQ, to compare. Bypass goes off when you leave the EQ page.
- Mixer: the Pad page has the row EQ under the 4 slots. B3 or the ENCODER opens the EQ page of the pad. PAD FX goes back to the row EQ.
- Stereo for each pad (Play page, SHIFT + K3): a stereo sample plays only its left or right channel (mono, in the centre), or a blend of the two.
- New setting "Mute Type" (group SEQUENCE): how a pad mute and a track mute sound. Audio (default) stops the sound at once. Event stops only the new notes, and the notes that sound play to their end. It is for Mute mode, the Pad Mixer, Track Mute, the Ch. Mixer and Explode. Track Mute uses Audio by default. In 0.1.5 it sounded as Event.
- Mute groups for tracks and submixes: tracks (or submixes) in the same group mute and unmute together. Set them with K2 (Trk Grp, Sub Grp) on the Mixer. K2 on the Pad page (Pad Grp) is the stock pad Mute Grp. On the Ch. Mixer and the Pad Mixer, SHIFT + K2 sets the group of the selected strip. Track Mute shows the group of each track.
- MIDI out: each track can have its own MIDI channel (on the Mixer, Track page). A Scale, Tune or KEYS note of that track goes out as the real note, also chords, live and in the recording. One track plays one part of an external synth. Off: the track sends no MIDI. Global: the track follows MIDI Config, as in stock. The track grid shows the channel.
- Dup. Track: a copy of a track, directly after the track. All pads, samples, effects and routes stay. With Events On (B2) the events (notes and automation) of all sequences go along too. In the Track View, SHIFT + B3 (Dupl/Expl) asks first: B2 Dup. Track or B3 Explode.
- Song mode: SHIFT + B2 (Clear All) removes all sequences from the song at once. UNDO brings the song back.
- Song mode: with Settings > Song Pads = Quick Add, a pad inserts its sequence into the song at once (no B3).
- Song mode shows the name of each sequence after its number, for example "A01 Intro".
- Automate: Remove deletes the fade of the selected target (Volume, LP Filter or HP Filter) in the selection. Remove All (SHIFT) deletes all fades of the selected tracks in the sequence. One UNDO brings them back.
- Selection loop: the loop stays on every screen and after STOP. SHIFT + PLAY plays it again, also with SEQ RECORD. PLAY plays from bar 1 and ends the loop.
- Track Mute: hold SEQ and push a pad to select a sequence. Track Mute stays on.
- Select a track: the grid title shows the track that you will get, for example "Track 04". This also shows on the Mixer, which has no track label.
- Pad Mixer: a pad that you play selects its strip.
- Pad View: with Steps on, hold SAMPLE and push a pad to select that row. Steps stays on. While you hold SAMPLE, the pads light as on the SAMPLE screen.
- Chop Mode: Chop Type Regions also gives 128 regions. Threshold makes up to 128 slices (all 8 pad banks): set the most in Settings > Threshold Max Slices (16, 32, 64 or 128; default 16, as stock).
- Chop Mode: when you tap the 16th chop of a pad bank, the next pad bank shows at once. Tap the next chop on its first pad.
- New setting "Mixer Opens On" (group FX & AUTOMATION): the page that the Mixer shows when it opens. Pad inserts, Ch. Mixer or Last Used (default, as before).
- Settings > Ask Before Erase Pad: ERASE + pad asks before it erases a pad with a sample (Cancel or Do It!). Default Off.
- Settings > SAMPLE BROWSER > Fader Scrolls List: Off gives the FADER its FADER menu function in the browsers again (for example Pad Volume).
- Load Project and Load Kit check the free memory first. A project that is too big for the free memory (for example 16 tracks with about 60 full sequences) gives the message "Not Enough Memory" and does not load, so the MPC does not freeze.

## Changed in 0.2.0

- Automate: a fade belongs to the sequence where you write it. The other sequences play your own volume or filter value.
- Pad colours: Step Edit Play, the Track View and the Mixer Pad page show the pads as the SAMPLE screen. Track Mute: green plays, red muted. While you select a track (SHIFT + PAD BANK, PAD BANK after an ENCODER turn, or the Mixer Track page with PAD FX held), the pads show the tracks and a pad selects that track: green, the current track bright, a muted track red, the ENCODER target white. PAD BANK alone still shows the bank colours on pads 1 to 8.
- UNMUTE ALL (SHIFT + MUTE) also unmutes all muted tracks, on every screen (in 0.1.5 only in Track Mute). It is one undo step: UNDO brings all the mutes back. In stock it had no undo. During a recording, the MPC records it, as before.
- Explode and Dup. Track of a track with track effects: To Submix puts the effects one time on a free submix, and all the tracks go to that submix. This uses much less CPU than one copy of the effects per track.
- Chop Mode Extract to a new track, from a pad with effects: To Track puts the effects one time on the new track, not on each chop pad.
- Chop Mode: Extract asks for the pad of the (first) chop. Push a pad to select it. The pad lights show where the chops go. The chops go on the pads in a row from there. When a pad in the way has a sample, Do It! becomes Replace. When the chops do not fit from that pad, Do It! is off. Track also has New Track: the chops go to a new track after the current track. Track can also replace the source pad with its own chop. K2 sets the mute group of the chop pads (at the start, the group of the source pad), so a chop can stop the chop before it.
- Resample Pad: K1 sets the tail, without SHIFT. The line under "Select pad" always shows the Knob FX print and the Pad FX print.
- Resample Pad keeps the chops of a chopped pad. The new sample has the same chops at the same places in the sound (also with Tune, Warp and Reverse). Before, the new sample had no chops.
- 16 Levels Scale: Chromatic is the first scale (K2). Each pad plays one semitone higher. A chord plays the same chord shape on each pad. After the update, K2 can show the scale before your saved scale (for example Major instead of Minor). Set it again.
- 16 Levels Scale Arp: with Chord on, the Arp plays the chord tones one at a time, as the MPC arpeggiator. One pad gives an arpeggio of its chord. Before, each step played the full chord.
- COPY a pad to another track: the display shows the destination track when you turn the ENCODER, also before you push a destination pad.
- A push of SAMPLE closes Track Mute, also when you are on the SAMPLE screen already.
- The Mixer, Pad View and Track View open faster.
- The TAP TEMPO light does not flash with the tempo. It stays on, a little dimmed.
- Settings: Knob FX List and Insert FX List are two separate lists. Hide an effect in one list and keep it in the other. The Insert FX List can also hide the 4 insert-only effects. After the update, the Insert FX List shows all effects: open it and set Off the effects that you hid before in the FX Select List.
- Settings: the Battery Monitor is removed. Its charge did not follow the battery. Use the stock battery light.
- Stock project: if not all pads used the Knob FX on stock, the Knob FX starts bypassed. Then no pad gets an effect that it did not have on stock. If all pads used it, it stays on.
- If SampQOL OS stops during SD Card Access, the computer loses the card before the MPC uses it again, so the two never use the card at the same time.
- After a crash, autorun/logs/last-exit.log on the card holds the crash details of the mod. Send the folder autorun/logs with a bug report.

## Fixed in 0.2.0

releases.name: SampQOL OS 0.1.5 (beta)
releases.body:
SampQOL OS is a free mod for the MPC Sample firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12). It starts from the SD card and does not change the stock firmware. With the SD card in, it starts by itself. Without the SD card, the MPC starts as stock 1.3.0.

Tested only with MPC Sample 1.3.0. MPC One, Live and X are not tested yet. This is beta software: back up your projects first. A failed project load can delete samples (see the manual, "Project safety net").

## New in 0.1.5

- Track mutes per sequence, as on the MPC Live: each sequence keeps its own track mutes. A song that you export to a sequence keeps the track mutes of each part.
- Hold PAD BANK and push - or +: the current track moves one place up or down. One UNDO moves it back.
- Note Repeat works in Step Edit: in the Pad View (also with Steps on) and in the Track View.
- Step Edit: cut notes and paste them in another place. Pad View: Cut (SHIFT + B1). Track View: Copy the notes, then ERASE them.
- Sample Select: SHIFT + K2 "Own Sample": pads with a sample play their own sound next to the preview, so you can compare files with your kit.
- Sample Select: New Folder also works in an empty folder.
- Browsers: the FADER scrolls the list, as a scrollbar.
- Resample Pad can also print the Pad FX that are on (Fixed or Latch). You set the Pad FX print and the Knob FX print On or Off. SHIFT + K1 sets the tail (0 to 10 seconds).
- Pad FX: Fixed effects stay on when you leave the Pad FX screen, as Latch.
- SHIFT + PAD FX can open the stock Pad FX screen at once (Settings > Shortcuts).
- Ch. Mixer: Mute on a track strip and Track Mute are one mute.
- FX Select and the Insert FX list show an icon for each effect group.
- Sample Tail and 16 Levels Scale: the encoder changes the value of the last knob that you turned.

## Fixed in 0.1.5

- Load Kit and Load Project: two drum tracks with the same name lost notes when you saved. Each track gets its own name (for example "Drum 001-2") and keeps its notes.
- Load Kit, then UNDO: the next save could crash when two tracks had the name of the kit.
- Half Seq and Double Seq (SHIFT + PAD 2 / 3) change all drum tracks. They changed only track 1.
- Track Mute: the pad of a muted track is light red. It was off, as a pad without a track.
- Pad EQ: a kill also stops the attack of a new note. The first part of a snare or a clap went through the kill.
- MAIN VOLUME works in the Pad View and the Track View. It did nothing there, or it changed the steps.
- Step Edit keeps the cursor, the selection and the copied notes when you open a stock screen (for example Resample or the FADER menu) and go back. The Pad View opened again at step 1.
- Track View: Paste after Copy and ERASE puts the notes back in the same place. Paste did nothing there.
- Track View: Copy and Duplicate take up to 8192 notes. With more than 512 notes, they copied only a part. With more than 8192 notes, the MPC shows "Too many notes".
- The folder pages (Home Folder, Save Sample, Save Project, Export) go up to the root of the SD card, as Sample Select. They stopped in the folder MPC-Sample.
- Sample Select: a push on the selected pad on a folder does not open New Folder.
- Sample Select: Prev. Vol. does not cover a long folder name, and does not show on a folder.
- Sample Select: New Folder (B3) shows as a stock button, not as the Preview box.

## Known issues

- A stock MPC Sample does not play the track mutes in a sequence that you made with Song Export. All tracks sound there.
- Battery Monitor: the charge is an estimate from a voltage. It can stay at one value (for example 45%). The stock battery light shows the correct state.
- "Insufficient space on drive" is about the internal storage, not the SD card. The internal storage always keeps about 400 MB free. Save your projects and samples on the SD card. Keep the internal storage as stock as possible.
- Time signature (SHIFT + K2 on the SEQ screen): each change takes about 3 seconds. When you turn K2 fast, the changes add up and the MPC stops for some minutes. Do not turn off the MPC: it comes back by itself. Turn K2 one step and wait. We are working on a fix.
- When the MPC plays and you change the sequence (also in Song mode), you can hear a short gap or click. This occurs more with many tracks or effects. We are working on a fix.

All features and the buttons that work differently: see the [README](https://github.com/snarebes/SampQOL-OS#readme). CHANGELOG.md has all changes from stock 1.3.0. Manual.html in the zip shows how to use each function.

## Install

See the README for the newest version. Manual.html in this zip has the install steps for this version.

Download the zip only from this page or from beatops.io. Do not upload or share the zip (LICENSE.txt, section 3).
